batches.title: Core: IncludeScopes + scoped IConfigStore methods + polling merge
acceptance: DbConfigOptions.IncludeScopes default empty; non-empty triggers scoped polling
Polling loop merges entries lowest-precedence-first; own AppName last (wins ties)
Watermark reload triggers on any included scope's ModifiedUtc advance
Test doubles (FaultyWrapperStore, CountingWatermarkStore) get mechanical stubs

batches.title: EF Core: scoped query implementations + dual-DB integration tests
acceptance: GetAllScopedAsync issues a single SELECT with WHERE AppName IN (...) (verified via EF query logging)
GetLatestModifiedUtcScopedAsync issues a single SELECT MAX(ModifiedUtc) over the IN set
Parity tests on both SQL Server and PostgreSQL

batches.title: HTTP API: ?includeScopes query string on list endpoint
acceptance: GET /{app}/{env}?includeScopes=Shared,PlatformDefaults returns rows from all listed scopes
Each row's AppName field indicates source scope
Default (no query string) is unchanged: only own scope returned
Server does NOT merge — returns all rows; UI/consumer merges

batches.title: MapDbConfigHttp scopeFilter overload
acceptance: scopeFilter parameter accepted, default null
When set, an IEndpointFilter at the group level rejects mismatched {appName} routes with 403
Reload endpoint (no appName in route) always allowed
Without scopeFilter, behavior is unchanged (regression)

batches.title: UI: scope badge + view filter + per-row write guard

EntriesTable shows Scope column with colored badge (own = primary, shared = secondary)
ViewModeToggle (Mine/Shared/All) filters the visible rows
Edit/Delete buttons disabled on rows where row.appName !== ownScope
CreateEntryDialog includes scope selector (defaults to own)
npm run build clean
verification: cd ui && npm run build → 0 errors

completed_batches.behavioral_diff: DbConfigOptions gains IncludeScopes; IConfigStore gains GetAllScopedAsync and GetLatestModifiedUtcScopedAsync as required methods; polling provider merges entries lowest-precedence-first with own AppName always winning ties; InMemoryConfigStore gets mechanical scoped implementations.

deviations.detail: FaultyWrapperStore and CountingWatermarkStore test doubles received mechanical GetAllScopedAsync and GetLatestModifiedUtcScopedAsync stubs
deviations.justification: Interface-compliance addition required by the new required methods; no logic change.

completed_batches.behavioral_diff: EfCoreConfigStore.GetAllScopedAsync issues a single SELECT with WHERE AppName IN (...) then re-orders results in memory to match input list order (SQL IN does not preserve order); GetLatestModifiedUtcScopedAsync issues a single SELECT MAX(ModifiedUtc) over the IN set. Parity tests on both SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

ListEntriesEndpoint accepts optional ?includeScopes query string; when present it calls GetAllScopedAsync with the appName list (path appName appended last); server returns raw ordered rows — no server-side merging; each row's AppName field identifies the source scope. Default behavior (no query string) is unchanged.

MapDbConfigHttp gains optional scopeFilter parameter; when set an IEndpointFilter at the group level rejects requests whose {appName} route value differs from the filter with 403; the /reload endpoint (no appName route value) is always allowed; without scopeFilter behavior is unchanged.

React UI gains: ScopeSelector persists IncludeScopes to localStorage; EntriesTable shows Scope column with colored badge (own = primary, shared = secondary); ViewModeToggle (Mine/Shared/All) filters visible rows; Edit/Delete buttons disabled on rows where entry.AppName !== ownScope; CreateEntryDialog includes scope selector defaulting to own scope.

Docs-only: README gains Shared scopes subsection with worked example and per-scope auth pattern; Status updated to v0.4.0; Known Limitations updated (single-scope constraint removed, UseCustomStore deferred to v0.5.0). architecture.md gains §2.11 (scope merging and precedence) and §2.1 updated to mention IncludeScopes. project-specific.md gains §8.8 (shared scopes conventions and auth). CLAUDE.md gains §0.6 (scopeFilter auth rule) and Standards Reference table updated to v0.4.0 with section ranges. lessons.md appends L18-L20. todo.md ticks all v0.4.0 batches and adds Deferred to v0.5.0+ section.

implement.behavioral_diff: v0.4.0 delivered: DbConfigOptions.IncludeScopes enables multi-scope polling with explicit precedence (own AppName always wins); IConfigStore gains two required scoped methods (GetAllScopedAsync, GetLatestModifiedUtcScopedAsync) implemented in EfCoreConfigStore via single IN-clause queries with in-memory ordering; ListEntriesEndpoint accepts ?includeScopes for on-demand merged reads; MapDbConfigHttp gains optional scopeFilter for per-scope group-level authorization; React UI renders scope badges, a view-mode toggle, per-row write guards, and a scope selector in the create dialog. Test suite grew 85 → 122.
